claim_boundary.positive_claim: simulated robot-environment contact/separation proxy over the committed one-tick horizon
claim_boundary.true_future_limitation: actual transition geometry is an observability upper bound and does not establish pre-action prediction

primary_rules.BODY_CENTRIC_MOUNT_REQUIRED: dense platform-mount FOV fails and dense body-centric single-origin passes
primary_rules.RANGE_SENSOR_CONTRACT_UNRESOLVED: realistic platform condition cannot be specified; dense conditions still execute
primary_rules.SCAN_DENSITY_OR_TIMING_BOTTLENECK: realistic platform fails and dense platform-mount FOV passes

compute_benchmark.condition: DENSE_BODY_CENTRIC_SINGLE_ORIGIN true-future, the prospectively strongest condition
compute_benchmark.decision_unit: the complete 24-state development-held-out set per timed sample; each sample includes every current action and every associated next-action set

conditions.pose_semantics: reproduce the predecessor yaw-only body pose for both baseline mount and rays; roll and pitch are deliberately stripped only for condition A
conditions.scan_timing: planning-time uses one instantaneous boundary sweep at t=0; true-future uses the deterministic union of instantaneous sweeps at t=0 and the actual terminal boundary t=0.1, reproducing the predecessor boundary-union contract

conditions.ray_semantics: mathematical directional continuum with exact first-hit visibility

conditions.purpose: strongest single physically plausible body-origin observability upper bound
conditions.ray_semantics: full-sphere mathematical directional continuum with exact first-hit visibility

coverage_attribution.classification_rule: exactly one primary error class per error; UNRESOLVED is fail-closed
coverage_attribution.condition_specific_hierarchy: scan pattern/timing counterfactuals apply only to REALISTIC_PLATFORM_SCAN; A uses its own blind/FOV/self/direct evidence, C compares platform to D, and D uses body blind/self/single-origin evidence
coverage_attribution.error_population: every development-held-out transition whose frozen-threshold contact prediction differs from the repaired frozen_contact_label, for every condition and evidence mode; decision-level unsafe selections and abstentions remain separately complete in viability metrics

error_witness_rule.false_negative: select the authoritative frozen first-contact step and agreeing attributed link; if the link is unresolved, retain UNRESOLVED and use the minimum-clearance link only to index diagnostic arrays
error_witness_rule.false_positive_unsupported: select the unsupported step/link with lowest exact clearance, then earliest step/link

coverage_attribution.point_accumulation_error_policy: report only with an explicit raw-return-versus-accumulated-cloud loss witness; otherwise do not infer this class from a whole-transition prediction mismatch
coverage_attribution.sparsity_timing_counterfactual: for the realistic condition, spatial support ignores emission time but preserves the exact boundary-keyed set of 6400 sensor-frame ray directions: at the target physics-step platform pose, a ray supports the closest-surface witness when its forward ray line passes within the frozen 0.10 m support radius and condition C proves direct target visibility. Temporal support additionally requires an actually timestamped accumulated B return within 0.10 m from the responsible object. Spatial absence is SCAN_PATTERN_SPARSITY; spatial presence with temporal absence is SCAN_TIMING_LIMITATION
coverage_attribution.temporal_support_rule: a realistic finite return supports an event only when its timestamp is no later than that physics-step event; later full-window returns remain available to the upper-bound cloud but are not temporal-support evidence

evidence_modes.dense_timing: continuum visibility of exact current geometry at t=0 only
evidence_modes.gate_status: reported separately; not the primary representation-sufficiency gate
evidence_modes.information_boundary: only points available at the current planning boundary
evidence_modes.motion_note: zero-order current-state hold is an explicit optimistic causal observation approximation. Offline scoring still queries that causal cloud against the frozen actual 50-step protected sweep and labels, solely to measure whether current evidence covers the later body volume; future geometry never enters point generation and is not deployable planning-time information
evidence_modes.sparse_timing: use t in [-0.1,0); because predecessor prehistory is not in the frozen corpus, hold exact current articulated geometry constant over that trailing window

evidence_modes.dense_timing: accumulated union of target-directed continuum visibility at t=0 and all 50 exact post-step endpoints t=0.002,...,0.100 seconds; full support is any acquisition, while event-time support is separately restricted to acquisitions no later than the protected witness time
evidence_modes.information_boundary: points generated or received during the actual committed 100 ms transition
evidence_modes.motion_note: uses actual current-to-successor geometry as a true-future observability upper bound
evidence_modes.prediction_disclaimer: does not establish that future geometry is available or predictable before execution
evidence_modes.sparse_timing: use t in [0,0.1) at the frozen deterministic ray timestamps

fixtures.gate: all fixtures must pass before the first scientific sensor result is calculated
required: contact inside the near blind region

coordinate_frame.origin: centre of the bottom mounting surface
coordinate_frame.z_axis: outward normal of the bottom mounting surface

excluded_local_l1_scaffold.exclusion_reason: upstream simulation scaffold on a pinned_pending_license_and_build_audit backend; not present in platform sensors_required and explicitly dropped from corpus scope

fov.elevation_interval_basis: inference from the documented 96 degree wide/negative-angle mode and documented negative-angle extent

hardware_binding.local_bom_audit: no exact intended range sensor is selected in the local Go2 platform manifest, hardware/BOM material, or prior RGB-only progression contract. The pinned, pending-license/build-audit third-party Gazebo xacro includes a generic L1 visual and synthetic gpu_lidar scaffold, but sensors_required does not select it, it was not captured, and the README explicitly drops lidar from the v3 corpus
hardware_binding.reason: local BOM/platform documents do not select an exact range sensor; this is an explicit development assumption, not a final deployment selection

timestamps.cloud_stamp: start time of the point cloud
timestamps.qualification: preserve a deterministic timestamp for every ray/point
timestamps.system_mode: system wall time minus one scan period

definition: each family with a positive contact has combined current/successor recall >= 0.80
each family with both contact classes has combined AUC >= 0.75
each family with oracle-viable states retains an action for at least one such state
every oracle-nonviable state in every family abstains

body_centric.mounting_uncertainty: development assumption; physical installation not calibrated
body_centric.selection_rule: top-centre of trunk collision-envelope bounding box plus clearance
body_centric.tuning: single prospectively selected mount; no contact-label or outcome tuning

platform.coordinate_convention: URDF fixed-joint parent-to-child origin, RPY radians

emitting_housing_ray_policy.limitation: whole coarse housing primitives are omitted rather than a CAD-resolved aperture, so B/C remain optimistic physical-coverage upper bounds
emitting_housing_ray_policy.reason: the nominal radar optical origin lies inside both coarse head-housing collision primitives; those coarse solids do not encode the optical aperture
emitting_housing_ray_policy.scope: exclude only geometry indices 1 and 2 from B/C self-ray intersection; retain both unchanged as protected contact and clearance geometry; every other articulated collision primitive remains a self-occluder

platform.mounting_uncertainty: physical calibration and manufacturing tolerance unquantified
platform.ray_frame_mapping: the deterministic scan-pattern FRU axes are interpreted directly as the URDF radar child-frame +X forward, +Y left, +Z up axes before applying the fixed-joint rotation
platform.source: stock Unitree Go2 base-to-radar fixed joint
platform.tuning: selected before contact outcomes; no mount search

sparse_baseline.tuning: frozen predecessor value; no outcome tuning

outputs: per-link minimum clearance through the committed tick
lower confidence bound or uncertainty interval

predecessor_bindings.contact_attribution_authority: use the frozen first-contact physics step; link/object attribution is native-replay only when both its verdict and first-contact step agree with the frozen label, otherwise history-free exact-query attribution only when both its verdict and first-contact step agree, otherwise UNRESOLVED; reconstruction verdicts never alter the frozen target
predecessor_bindings.contact_authority: repaired frozen_contact_label bound by the repaired row ledger; this is the predecessor's authoritative physics-rate H1 target and is never replaced by native-replay or history-free exact-query reconstruction

prohibitions: opening or executing the JEPA predictor
changing frozen state identities or role membership
changing action identities or the action bank
reading or opening untouched G2 evaluation
restarting or reinterpreting completed occupancy v4
implementing memory, novelty, routing, or beacon capture
persisting non-audit raw scientific point clouds

raw_audit_subset.dense_continuum_rule: a continuum has no finite complete cloud; persist the frozen per-step/per-link closest-surface target witnesses, acquisition times, and compact support/nominal/self/environment visibility matrices. These exact target-directed queries determine the prospectively frozen witness estimator but are not a replacement finite angular scan
raw_audit_subset.fixtures: retain the canonical complete synthetic fixture inputs, exact first-hit/per-link outputs, and full ray-pattern parameter/digest receipts in the tracked fixture artifact; fixture point sets are fixed inline constants and need not be duplicated as binary clouds
raw_audit_subset.rank_input: namespace UTF-8 || 0x00 || canonical UTF-8 JSON of transition_uid, role, family, and transition_kind
raw_audit_subset.scientific_selection: within each (role, family, transition_kind) stratum, retain the single lowest SHA-256 ranked transition identity
raw_audit_subset.selected_transition_retention: retain finite raw clouds for all four conditions and both evidence modes

realistic_scan_approximation.boundary_snapshot_binding: lowercase SHA-256 hex digest of the exact planning-boundary embodied and environment snapshot already bound by the frozen predecessor geometry
realistic_scan_approximation.candidate_invariance: every candidate action evaluated at the same planning boundary uses the same phase; candidate identity and successor endpoint are excluded from phase derivation
realistic_scan_approximation.phase_continuity: planning window t in [-0.1,0) and true-future window t in [0,0.1) share the same boundary-keyed phase at t=0
realistic_scan_approximation.phase_digest: SHA-256(namespace UTF-8 || 0x00 || raw 32-byte boundary snapshot SHA-256)
realistic_scan_approximation.randomness: none; phase hashing is deterministic and outcome-independent
realistic_scan_approximation.reason: the proprietary exact non-repetitive ray sequence is unavailable
realistic_scan_approximation.successor_boundary_rule: a successor transition row uses the exact snapshot digest of that successor/current planning boundary, shared across all next-action candidates from it
realistic_scan_approximation.timestamp_law: t_k = (k + 0.5) / 64000 seconds in the 100 ms window

recovery_lineage.scope: Recovery completed successfully. The proposed body-centric sensor qualification did not run because no executable experiment contract existed. This contract prospectively defines a new scientific experiment after recovery.

development_held_out.use: evaluation only after all thresholds are frozen

training.use: reporting and materialisation only; never threshold or mount selection

scientific_question: Can a physically plausible body-relevant range-sensor configuration observe enough geometry to reproduce the exact per-link two-ply micro-viability decision?

seeds.ray_phase_source: deterministic exact planning-boundary snapshot SHA-256; shared by all candidates

source_and_environment.environment_policy: use predecessor-compatible environment; do not install or upgrade opportunistically
source_and_environment.source_closure_timing: persist before the first scientific sensor result is calculated

materialization_parallelism.index_order: canonical frozen state order independent of completion order
materialization_parallelism.state_isolation: one frozen state per task; distinct output paths

storage.preflight_rule: stop before materialisation unless device identity, filesystem type, free-space floors, and predicted temporary/final byte ceilings all pass

threshold_calibration.candidate_enumeration: every distinct finite calibration score plus the two exterior decision sentinels
threshold_calibration.contact_rule: score <= threshold is predicted contact; exact ties are contact-positive
threshold_calibration.heldout_isolation: development-held-out outcomes may not select thresholds, mounts, scan laws, or conditions
lexicographic_selection: highest oracle-viable states retaining a derived viability-admissible action
highest correct abstention count on oracle-nonviable states
more conservative threshold (numerically larger clearance threshold)
threshold_calibration.scope: one threshold independently for each condition and evidence mode
threshold_calibration.score: continuous global minimum observed environment clearance in metres

timebase.interval_convention: half-open [0.0, 0.1) for sampled rays; terminal state at 0.1

two_ply_viability.admission_rule: admit only if the current tick is predicted contact-free and the actual successor has at least one predicted contact-free deployable next action
current_action_rule: derive immediate contact from sensor-derived per-link state
use the frozen actual successor state
derive contact for every unique deployable next action
two_ply_viability.safe_action_count_metric_denominator: every unique current candidate with its frozen successor action set, including candidates whose current tick has oracle contact

visibility_and_reduction.dense_semantics: analytic target-directed visibility, not a tunable finite angular grid. The exact, outcome-independent 50x13 closest-environment surface witnesses determine the frozen witness-weighted coverage and clearance metric; they are conservative sufficient queries, not a complete visible-surface cloud and not proof that hidden geometry could not be inferred
visibility_and_reduction.dense_support_provenance: select the latest supporting acquisition at or before the witness event; when none exists select the earliest later supporting acquisition; signed point age is event time minus selected acquisition time; deterministic acquisition index breaks all ties
visibility_and_reduction.environment_occlusion: nearest environment or robot collision-geometry intersection wins
visibility_and_reduction.global_minimum_use: a global minimum may only aggregate deterministic per-link state for contact filtering
visibility_and_reduction.ground_return_handling: the analytic ground plane participates as a first-hit occluder and its return count/identity is retained, but ground points are excluded from disallowed-environment clearance and local target support. This reproduces the predecessor sparse baseline's post-render removal of ground-plane points at z <= 0.025 m while retaining their occlusion effect
visibility_and_reduction.inherited_support_provenance: finite_scan_support_inherited=true binds the B ray index/time/range; dense acquisition indices are -1/null because no discrete continuum acquisition produced that inherited ray
visibility_and_reduction.local_target_support_rule: sparse local point support requires an environment return from the responsible object within 0.10 m Euclidean distance of the closest-surface target witness; selected prospectively without outcome data
visibility_and_reduction.local_target_support_scope: support and attribution only; continuous clearance remains the exact point-to-protected-primitive reduction
visibility_and_reduction.motion_compensation: transform each valid return using the exact articulated/body pose at its timestamp into the immutable world frame and reduce against the world-frame articulated sweep; this is rigid-transform equivalent to moving both cloud and sweep into the current-boundary body reference. Between adjacent frozen 2 ms physics samples use linear position interpolation and shortest-arc normalized linear quaternion interpolation; never extrapolate beyond the frozen trace
visibility_and_reduction.near_blind_semantics: intersections inside minimum range remain occluders but yield no valid environment range point

obstacle_sector_rule.angle: atan2(left, forward) in radians, wrapped to [-pi, pi)
obstacle_sector_rule.tie_rule: add pi/8 then floor modulo eight; exact upper ties enter the next CCW sector

visibility_and_reduction.planning_motion_compensation: current geometry is held fixed over its causal trailing observation window; the resulting cloud is retrospectively reduced against the actual frozen candidate sweep as an evaluation target
visibility_and_reduction.point_age_definition: signed event-relative age = protected-witness physics time minus return timestamp; negative values explicitly mean the nearest supporting return arrived after that event
visibility_and_reduction.point_validity: finite first environment return within inclusive [minimum_range, maximum_range], not robot-self, with a valid timestamp and direction
visibility_and_reduction.realistic_dense_platform_dominance: condition C support is the union of exact target-directed continuum support and any valid condition B same-object return within the frozen 0.10 m witness radius. Such a B ray necessarily exists in C's identical mount/FOV/range continuum. B support must therefore imply C support for every witness; inherited finite-ray provenance is flagged
visibility_and_reduction.robot_self_occlusion: exact articulated collision geometry blocks rays except the prospectively frozen platform emitting-housing ray-only exemption for geom indices 1 and 2 in B/C
visibility_and_reduction.swept_volume_support_estimator: for each protected link, use the 50 equal-weight exact-physics-step closest-environment surface witnesses along the frozen articulated sweep; unsupported_swept_volume_fraction is the fraction of those 50 witnesses without condition-valid support. This is a prospectively frozen witness-weighted swept-volume coverage estimator, not an exact Lebesgue-volume measurement
visibility_and_reduction.transition_unsupported_rule: a transition is unsupported risk when any protected-link physics-step closest-surface witness lacks condition-valid support; this full protected-sweep rule is outcome-blind and may not be reduced to the oracle contact or minimum-clearance link after outcomes
visibility_and_reduction.unsupported_contact_rule: an unsupported transition is predicted contact/risk independently of the finite clearance threshold; unsupported protected volume is never treated as free
